A batting blitz followed by a bowling masterclass!
United Tigers piled up 140/6 in just 10 overs, with Azmatullah Omarzai and Abbas Afridi providing a spectacular finish. The bowlers then stepped up to restrict Arabian Aces to 89/9, sealing a dominant 51-run victory!
